title: Hausdorff-measure scaling under the blow-up map η_{x,r}
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ}, r > 0 and η_{x,r}(y) := r⁻¹(y − x) (Chapter03.blowUpMap x r); write Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^{n+ℓ}. Then for every set B ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} (no measurability assumed): (i) rⁿ·Hⁿ(η_{x,r}(B)) = Hⁿ(B) in [0, ∞]; (ii) the push-forward of the restricted measure Hⁿ⌞B under η_{x,r} equals rⁿ·(Hⁿ⌞η_{x,r}(B)).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (x : Amb n ℓ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∀ B : Set (Amb n ℓ), ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n) * (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' B) = (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) B ∧ ((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict B).map (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r) = ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n) • (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' B)
